answer:
The film **“Grievous Bodily Harm”** is an Australian production.  
In Australia, conscription was introduced during the Vietnam War by the passage of the **National Service Act 1964**. The Act was assented to and came into force on **24 November 1964** (the decision to introduce national service had been announced on 10 November 1964). Thus, conscription was introduced in Australia in **1964** while the Vietnam War was ongoing.
